name: Kabocha Squash
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in SIBO protocols. The low fiber content and natural sweetness make it a good carbohydrate option during symptom flares.
preparationTips: Roast with olive oil and low-FODMAP herbs for enhanced flavor
Steam or boil until tender for easier digestion
Remove skin after cooking if you have sensitive digestion
Can be pureed into soups or used as a base for FODMAP-friendly curries
nutritionalHighlights: High in beta-carotene and vitamin A
